Per-partner block 6+2H+2 -> v2v_dim 72 (K4, H5); the new input columns are zero-initialised. The lane intent head trains beside the command intent head (v2v_intent.PPOIntent: masked MSE vs the realised signed lane choices at t+1..t+H, v2v_intent_loss-weighted via lane_intent_loss_weight, detach_trunk honoured); v2v_intent.refresh_bank_intents refreshes partner lane intents from the CURRENT head on the partners' own t-1 bank contexts (never recorded data); bank pairs carry 72-wide blocks with lane slots built empty (bank_v2v.attach_pairs lane_board forwarding; replay_bank threads lane_actions).
